# workflow

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/kit/workflow"
```

Package workflow plugs kit's workflows in: the state machines a service declares over the entities of its stores — their event, timer and guard transitions, their hooks and their loop —, which the SDK's statemachine runs. A product that declares one imports it:

```
import _ "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/kit/workflow"
```

A product that declares none does not, and links none of that engine; a program that declares one without it is refused at the start, the refusal naming this import (CodeSubsystemMissing). It imports framework/kit/store: a workflow runs over a store. framework/kit imports it too until ADR 0179's last step: no product needs the line yet.
